pages:
Lumi the firefly blinked. Blink, blink. The night was dark! Usually, the moonbeams made everything sparkly. But tonight? No moonbeams! Uh oh. A magical mystery needs solving! Lumi felt a little scared. Lumi took a deep breath. In... and out... like a sleepy cloud. That's better. Lumi is brave and kind, and Lumi can help!

First, Lumi flew to a flower. A big, red poppy. 'Hello, Poppy,' Lumi blinked. 'Have you seen the moonbeams?' The poppy yawned. 'Nope. Just smelled the sweet night air.' Lumi kept flying.

Lumi flew higher, past the sleepy trees. Still no moonbeams! Lumi saw a little puddle. Usually, the moonbeams made the puddle sparkle. But not tonight. Lumi felt a little sad. It was hard to see in the dark. Lumi whispered, 'I am brave! I am kind!' That helped. Then, Lumi blinked again, as bright as could be. And again! And again! Suddenly, the puddle sparkled! Lumi's bright blinks were the moonbeams!

The puddle shimmered and the light bounced everywhere!

The light from the puddle bounced up to the sky! The sleepy trees woke up and whispered, 'Wow!' Lumi’s blinking made all the shadows go away. Everything was bright and sparkly again. Lumi felt happy! The magical mystery was solved because Lumi is brave and kind! Lumi flew back to the poppy. The poppy smiled. 'Thank you, Lumi!' Lumi blinked a goodnight to the poppy, and then flew home, ready for a good night's sleep. Lumi is the brave little firefly!
